wodRaw: Workout 16.2 Complete as many rounds and reps as possible in 4, 8, 12, 16 or 20 minutes of: 25 toes-to-bars 50 double-unders 15 squat cleans* Begin with a 4 minute time cap. Etc., adding 4 minutes per round completed for up to 20 minutes. *1st round, 15 reps at 135 / 85 lb. 2nd round, 13 reps, 185 / 115 lb. 3rd round, 11 reps, 225 / 145 lb. 4th round, 9 reps, 275 / 175 lb. 5th round, 7 reps, 315 / 205 lb. Post rounds/reps completed to comments and/or submit your score as part of the 2016 Reebok CrossFit Games Open .

otherRaw:
<hr>
Brian Woehlke, 29, of Detroit, Michigan, died at the scene of a fire in Westland, Michigan, on May 8, 2013. Woehlke graduated from the Schoolcraft Fire Program in 2008 and joined the Western Wayne Fire Authority in 2012.
 
He is survived by his wife, Jennifer; daughter, Ava; parents, William and Elizabeth; brothers, William, Robert and Bradley; and numerous other friends and family members.
